description: This file defines two Odoo models for reporting: 'report.workcenter.load' and 'report.mrp.inout'. It includes database view initialization methods for generating reports on workcenter load and stock value variation.

classes.name: report_workcenter_load
classes.description: Model representing workcenter load report, with fields for week, workcenter, cycle, and hours.

classes.name: report_mrp_inout
classes.description: Model representing stock value variation report, with fields for week and stock value.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes database views for the respective report models.
